mapper.select: SELECT scr.id AS id, scr.check_number AS checkNumber, scr.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.specification AS specification, p.unit AS unit, scr.actual_quantity AS actualQuantity, scr.system_quantity AS systemQuantity, scr.difference AS difference, scr.unit_price AS unitPrice, scr.difference_amount AS differenceAmount, scr.operator_id AS operatorId, COALESCE(op.real_name, op.username) AS operatorName, scr.remark AS remark, scr.status AS status, scr.create_time AS createTime FROM stock_check_record scr LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = scr.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_user op ON op.id = scr.operator_id WHERE scr.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_check_record SET check_number = #{checkNumber}, product_id = #{productId}, actual_quantity = #{actualQuantity}, system_quantity = #{systemQuantity}, difference = #{difference}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, difference_amount = #{differenceAmount}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
